rooms.name: The Mound Road
rooms.desc: Wolves among the grave mounds.
rooms.idea: The wolves hunt the back rank and howl; the Draugr holds. Cover the rear and end it fast.

rooms.name: The Leper Path
rooms.desc: Bells in the snow.
rooms.idea: Two bells of stress and two Cryo-rot touches; kill the lepers before the max HP cuts pile up.

rooms.name: The Mould Vault
rooms.desc: Beetles, mould and a worm in the grave-rot.
rooms.idea: The Wight's Regen keeps the beetles and worm up, and the beetles push a hero to the end of the Ordo; burn the Wight first.

rooms.name: The Burial Hall
rooms.desc: The household, still at the table. The fool is on the dais steps.
rooms.idea: The Fool's joke grows each round he is left alone; one cheap hit a round on him starts it over.

rooms.name: New Graves
rooms.desc: Fresh graves in frozen earth, and the people who fill them.
rooms.idea: The Gravedigger makes the weakest Vulnerable and the Rat-Catcher fills hands with fleas; kill the Swollen without fire if the company is low.

rooms.name: The Walled Door
rooms.desc: A mason laying stones across a doorway, from this side.
rooms.idea: The Mason Stuns and shields the Swollen; burst her when the company can carry the Toxin, never with fire on her.

rooms.name: The Niches
rooms.desc: Burial niches from floor to vault, some of them empty.
rooms.idea: Slowed heroes act last and the worm heals on its bites; burst order matters more than total damage.

rooms.name: The Dais
rooms.desc: The king's empty dais, his hawk on its block.
rooms.idea: The Mason walls in the front while the Fool's joke builds and the hawk rakes anyone; reach the back rank or heckle the Fool.

rooms.name: The Thane's Barrow
rooms.desc: A lord with his household, and his fool.
rooms.idea: His household cannot be moved, so push and pull plans fail; killing one of them triggers his Oath.

rooms.name: The Witch's Tomb
rooms.desc: She is tending the dead on her slab.
rooms.idea: She strips courses from her allies every round and heals them all; she is the target.

rooms.name: The Chaplain's Rites
rooms.desc: A procession of one, his cross held high.
rooms.idea: Every death costs the company stress and his holy water shields his flock; kill him before the rest, with void if you have it.

rooms.name: The Pest-House
rooms.desc: The sick nailed in, and the man who nailed them.
rooms.idea: He Stuns the weakest hero and the fleas clog hands; plan defence before damage, not repair after.

rooms.name: The Barrow King
rooms.desc: The king of the sealed kingdom, on his grave-throne.
rooms.idea: Fire thaws him but bursts his buboes on every hero; burn him in short bursts and Ward before the Plague of Kings.

rooms.name: The Rat King
rooms.desc: A mound of rats three men high, among the grave goods.
rooms.idea: Every fall feeds it and every melee hit gives fleas; leave its escorts standing until it breaks, and hit it from range.

rooms.name: The Dead-Cart
rooms.desc: A cart under a heap of the dead, coming round again.
rooms.idea: It drags a hero up to rank 1 and Anchors it, and takes every fallen foe onto the heap; set ranks so the seized hero can stand there.

rooms.name: The Tepidarium
rooms.desc: Attendants with towels, and the physic who prescribes the rest.
rooms.idea: The towels wet, the flask burns: kill the Physic or Ward the wet hero.

rooms.name: The Hot Pools
rooms.desc: A crab in the shallows, a brute in the deep end, a nymph above both.
rooms.idea: Shell in front, the brute dunks behind it, the nymph veils both: frost cuts through all three.

rooms.name: Under the Floors
rooms.desc: Roaches pour from the grate; the stoker hooks from the dark.
rooms.idea: The hook drags a back hero forward into the roaches.

rooms.name: The Pump Room
rooms.desc: The mule still turns the wheel; leeches in the sludge.
rooms.idea: The mule ignores control; the leeches heal off you: burst it down.

rooms.name: The Lustral Gate
rooms.desc: A priest at the gate, a pilgrim, and a dog that bites everyone.
rooms.idea: The priest scalds the front two ranks, the pilgrim heals, the dog barks: break the sprinkle with Ward.

rooms.name: The Consulting Room
rooms.desc: Two healers behind a soft wall.
rooms.idea: Physical damage melts the brute, then reach rank 3 before the soaks top everyone up.

rooms.name: The Stoke Hole
rooms.desc: Pull, wet, burn, pinch.
rooms.idea: The full combo from three bodies; every hit on the crab costs the hitter Burn.

rooms.name: The Drained Cistern
rooms.desc: Four small bodies.
rooms.idea: Hits on every foe win; control does not.

rooms.name: The Mistress Receives
rooms.desc: While she lives the company stays wet.
rooms.idea: Every hero gains Soak each round, so every Burn is a Scald: kill her or Ward the beats.

rooms.name: The Furnace Stair
rooms.desc: The bearer comes up with both cauldrons full.
rooms.idea: Two cauldrons, two Scalds on the front ranks, then a round to strike back while it refills.

rooms.name: The Strigil Room
rooms.desc: He strips the guests, and the priest and the physic scald them.
rooms.idea: He scrapes the most armoured hero's Block and Armor and sheds courses; the priest and the Physic scald the stripped hero.

rooms.name: The Countess Is Carried In
rooms.desc: Her bearers, her dog and her pilgrim.
rooms.idea: She cannot be moved; the dog guards the wounded and her bell calls more of them.

rooms.name: The Simmering Matron
rooms.desc: The matron in her great pool.
rooms.idea: Land Conjunctions in one round once she sloughs; read the Heat count and Ward the boil-over.

rooms.name: The Best Families
rooms.desc: The seventh pool has come to complain.
rooms.idea: Spread the damage to share the complaints, then clear the bathers that fall out.

rooms.name: The Great Copper
rooms.desc: The boiler under every pool, and its shift.
rooms.idea: A damage race against the gauge; Weaken on the boiler stops the Pressure rising.

rooms.name: The Lamps Are Lit
rooms.desc: The bosun on the strand and two wreckers with their lamps.
rooms.idea: The Wreckers lure the back rank forward into the Bosun's axe; kill a Wrecker first to stop the pulls.

rooms.name: The Eel Shallows
rooms.desc: Things that bite, things that hold and things that shock.
rooms.idea: The crab Soaks, the octopus holds a hero so it cannot Swap out of the wet, the eels close the circuit.

rooms.name: The Harpy Rocks
rooms.desc: They ride the storm down, and the cragsman swings below them.
rooms.idea: Everything hits the back ranks; the front-rank wall has nothing to block. Protect the rear or kill fast.

rooms.name: The Wreck
rooms.desc: The merchant, the bosun and the drummer who calls the crew.
rooms.idea: The Merchant walls the front while the Drummer keeps calling crew; reach the Drummer or the fight never ends.

rooms.name: The Riding Light
rooms.desc: A lantern on a cow's horns, and the flock ahead of the gale.
rooms.idea: The cow guards whoever is hurt and the petrels feed Static to the eel-less line: switch targets or kill her first.

rooms.name: The Breakers' Yard
rooms.desc: A ship-breaker at work with his crowbar.
rooms.idea: The octopus pins the front hero and the Ship-Breaker pries its Block away first; Block-only defence fails.

rooms.name: The Gallery Rail
rooms.desc: Fliers round the lighthouse gallery.
rooms.idea: Fast fliers in a tight space; area damage pays, and the Wrecker's stress stacks if left alive.

rooms.name: Salvage
rooms.desc: The merchant hugs his box over the eel's pool.
rooms.idea: The Merchant guards the eel; break the guard or Ward the company before the discharge.

rooms.name: The Lighthouse
rooms.desc: The keeper tends the false light.
rooms.idea: The beam empties the front hero's hand and the fog strips Ward: play cards early and keep the lit hero dry.

rooms.name: The Matron's Roost
rooms.desc: The crowned harpy and her brood.
rooms.idea: Every harpy that dies feeds her Might; clear the brood with one area hit or go through it to her.

rooms.name: The Gibbet
rooms.desc: A cage on the headland, swinging in the storm.
rooms.idea: The irons count to the strike: kill the eel, stay dry, and Soak him, since rust eats the irons.

rooms.name: The Tideline
rooms.desc: She walks the strand after the wreck.
rooms.idea: She takes the Block the company banks and goes through full belts: spend what you gain the round you gain it.

rooms.name: The Thunder Whale
rooms.desc: The storm sings.
rooms.idea: Breach soaks the line and the Song runs through it: Ward and cleanse before the Song, and use rank 4.

rooms.name: The Last Prize
rooms.desc: The carrack lies heeled over on the rocks.
rooms.idea: Her crew holds the rail: once she lists, she is Soaked and the company's lightning finds her.

rooms.name: The Wind-Seller
rooms.desc: She stands on the sea-stack, worrying at the next knot.
rooms.idea: The gusts break the formation and Soak it; each knot is worse, so race her before the third.

rooms.name: The Flooded Stair
rooms.desc: Two thralls haul at the stair; a fisher casts from the landing.
rooms.idea: The reel drags a back hero forward into two hooks; tests Guard and hands that work from any rank.

rooms.name: The Eel Pools
rooms.desc: Things that bite, and keep biting.
rooms.idea: Latches Bleed until shaken off: hit the Biters or hit every foe.

rooms.name: The Barnacle Gate
rooms.desc: Two shells in front of a singer.
rooms.idea: Fire cracks the crab, lightning the knight; reach rank 3 or eat the song and the lure.

rooms.name: The Drowned Belfry
rooms.desc: A brute keeps the door while the choir sings and the ringer tolls.
rooms.idea: Stress race: the brute holds rank 1 behind the choirboy's hymn while the ringer tolls.

rooms.name: The Ossuary Tide
rooms.desc: A swollen body, a thrall and a sister who heals them both.
rooms.idea: Both sides Soak: whoever lands Void first wins. Drown the nun's healed thrall, or the burst Soaks you.

rooms.name: The Weeping Cloister
rooms.desc: Guard, heal and shield.
rooms.idea: A sustain wall that punishes low burst: kill the nun or the choirboy first.

rooms.name: The Anchor Line
rooms.desc: Knocked back, dragged forward, latched.
rooms.idea: Every rank gets moved: tests formations and hands that work from any rank.

rooms.name: The Swollen Nave
rooms.desc: Two bombs and the voice that cashes them.
rooms.idea: Kill the Siren before the bursts Soak the company, or Ward the back rank against her lure.

rooms.name: The Sunken Door
rooms.desc: The Tidewarden keeps the Siren's song.
rooms.idea: The lodger Erodes rank 1 and the sweep Soaks it: Drown on the front hero unless Warded or rotated.

rooms.name: The Silent Chapter
rooms.desc: Salt sermon in a drowned chapter house.
rooms.idea: She stands in front behind the knight's guard; her seal stitches a hand shut, and sermons and heals keep the chapter up.

rooms.name: The Breach
rooms.desc: The floor gives way to something enormous.
rooms.idea: The arm fills the front; grabbed heroes are dragged to rank 1 under it, with two latchers behind, and stay held until they strike the arm.

rooms.name: The Pearl Beds
rooms.desc: The diver goes for the back; the fisher reels the rest forward.
rooms.idea: The diver's knife hits the rearmost twice: Block the back ranks while the fisher reels heroes out of place.

rooms.name: The Drowned King
rooms.desc: The king on his throne, and his court.
rooms.idea: Kill the court before phase 3 or he eats it; Drown him on a decree turn to blank it.

rooms.name: The Bell Below
rooms.desc: The bell that rings for the drowned, and its choir.
rooms.idea: Three voices; the bell punishes many small hits, so big single blows carry this fight.

rooms.name: Mother of Brine
rooms.desc: The harbour midwife and her daughters.
rooms.idea: Every rank she empties fills with daughters; each kill costs the company stress.

rooms.name: The Frozen Deck
rooms.desc: Whalers at their stations, frozen to the rails.
rooms.idea: The harpoons drag the back rank forward into the cutlass; put the dragged hero back with Swap or keep it covered.

rooms.name: Gull Rookery
rooms.desc: The gulls have the rigging. A marine keeps order under it.
rooms.idea: The Marine punishes heroes who move in on him while the gulls stress the rear; area damage beats both flocks, and Thorns bite every peck.

rooms.name: The Ice Holes
rooms.desc: Holes in the floe, and things in the holes.
rooms.idea: The walrus guards the weakest, the eel and orca Soak and drag; Freeze the walrus and shatter it, or ignore it for the biters.

rooms.name: The Gun Deck
rooms.desc: A boy runs between the guns with a cartridge case.
rooms.idea: The boy loads the front man's next blow. Kill him first, or Freeze what he loads.

rooms.name: Weighing Anchor
rooms.desc: The capstan turns. The fiddler keeps time.
rooms.idea: The capstan grows every round and the boy loads it; kill it fast or keep the front two behind Block.

rooms.name: The Galley
rooms.desc: The pot is still on. Something is in it.
rooms.idea: The cook heals and stresses behind two bodies and ladles broth into hands; reach him or the fight drags.

rooms.name: Burial Detail
rooms.desc: Hammocks sewn shut, laid in rows. One is moving.
rooms.idea: The Sailmaker stitches heroes in place and drops more lice; kill lice when the front hero can take the Bleed.

rooms.name: The Lead
rooms.desc: A channel of black water between the floes.
rooms.idea: Three Soakers and chillers, and the orca drags a fresh hero into them; Ward or rotate the front, and do not Mark an eel you cannot kill.

rooms.name: The Captain's Cabin
rooms.desc: The captain at his frozen wheel, his crew at his flanks.
rooms.idea: His flank keeps its Block and he takes yours; kill the crew from the side he cannot cover, or burst him.

rooms.name: The Selkie's Floe
rooms.desc: She is singing on the ice. The gulls are listening.
rooms.idea: Heavy stress from song and gulls; open each round on her with a cheap hit to spend the stolen-skin Block.

rooms.name: The White Bear
rooms.desc: It came across the ice for the crews.
rooms.idea: It sheds courses every round and turns on the rear once it carries Frost; Freeze it in one round or hit it plainly.

rooms.name: The Cockpit
rooms.desc: The surgeon's table, and the lice under it.
rooms.idea: He saws the weakest hero and heals on every death; kill him before the crew, or stop leaving one hero low.

rooms.name: The Leviathan in the Ice
rooms.desc: The sea itself is frozen around it. The eye is open.
rooms.idea: White Breath soaks the company, then the jaw finds whoever struck it; once it rises, Ward before every Sea Freezes.

rooms.name: The Broadside
rooms.desc: A wall of black hull, every port open.
rooms.idea: Her broadside Freezes every Soaked hero; stay dry when she is loaded, then outlast her ripple or race it.

rooms.name: The Shrouds
rooms.desc: The rigging hangs over the ice, full of men.
rooms.idea: Topmen drop on anyone; the web hits physical hard, and when it parts it Anchors the company, so set ranks early.

rooms.name: The Anvil Line
rooms.desc: Slaves at the hammers, sparks everywhere.
rooms.idea: Static and Burn from every side: Plasma ignores Block, so Armor and Ward hold the line.

rooms.name: Bronze Watch
rooms.desc: An automaton, the smith beside it and the woman who winds it.
rooms.idea: Kill the Tender or the machine is wound back up; water cracks the machine.

rooms.name: The Bellows Roof
rooms.desc: Imps working the great bellows under the storm.
rooms.idea: The imps grow every Burn and the smith arcs it into Plasma: reach rank 3.

rooms.name: The Casting from Life
rooms.desc: A man in a mould, sparks round him, the warden behind.
rooms.idea: Many small hits crack the clay; the warden brands and fines from behind it and restores its Armor.

rooms.name: The Back Streets
rooms.desc: Coke, nails and a cat on the warm anvil.
rooms.idea: Nails and a Static coat: melee heroes pay to hit; reach and courses do not.

rooms.name: Feeding the Furnace
rooms.desc: The heaver, the fire's own creature and an imp.
rooms.idea: Burn stacks fast: frost the salamander and Ward against the splash.

rooms.name: Brands and Nails
rooms.desc: The guild's mark and a nail-maker's arm.
rooms.idea: Bleed from the nails, Burn from the salamander, and the Mark tells you where the next blow lands.

rooms.name: The Morning Winding
rooms.desc: Four bodies and a rewind.
rooms.idea: Hits on every foe, then the Tender before she winds the machine back up.

rooms.name: The Master Smith
rooms.desc: The Sparkblind Smith at his anvil, listening.
rooms.idea: He hears whoever strikes him and his brands follow: split the work across heroes or Guard the loud one.

rooms.name: Talos at the Gate
rooms.desc: A bronze giant, with its heel to the wall.
rooms.idea: Bleed the heel: the vein takes Bleed twice, until it plugs the vein; the warden keeps its Armor up.

rooms.name: The Wire Walk
rooms.desc: Live wire strung across the roof.
rooms.idea: The wire reaches further each round and drags the back forward: kill him before it reaches the back rank.

rooms.name: The Sledge Road
rooms.desc: The dray horse rears in its broken traces.
rooms.idea: Sparks off the hooves Static the front pair and the smith's weld lands the Plasma: Swap the pair apart.

rooms.name: The Anvil Titan
rooms.desc: The foundry's first and worst work.
rooms.idea: The Tender keeps the automaton coming; the Titan's third beat goes through Block: Armor and Ward the front.

rooms.name: The Crucible
rooms.desc: The great pot hangs tilted over the bell pit.
rooms.idea: Frost and Soak stop pours and delay the bell; the front line takes every wave.

rooms.name: The Storm-Catcher
rooms.desc: He holds the storm by two cables.
rooms.idea: Ward the marked heroes, Swap them away from Burned neighbours, and race him before he lets go.

rooms.name: The Overgrown Path
rooms.desc: Husks among the mushrooms, and roots with mouths.
rooms.idea: Husks burst on death; kill them with Ward up or from the back.

rooms.name: The Deer Glade
rooms.desc: They graze on the spores. Something watches from the wings.
rooms.idea: Stress from two sides; area damage.

rooms.name: The Hedge Maze
rooms.desc: A knight guards the turning.
rooms.idea: Thorns punish many hits; reach rank 3.

rooms.name: The Molehills
rooms.desc: The ground is soft here. Too soft.
rooms.idea: Anchored and pushed back, then healing shut off.

rooms.name: The Lily Pond
rooms.desc: The swans are the lady's.
rooms.idea: The strewer heals what the swan guards; burn the back.

rooms.name: The Kitchen Plot
rooms.desc: The fruit is ripe and the skep is full.
rooms.idea: Spore on clustered heroes; spread the ranks or cleanse.

rooms.name: The Rotting Bed
rooms.desc: A slow place. Nothing heals here.
rooms.idea: A slow grind with no healing; burst through it.

rooms.name: The Lady's Walk
rooms.desc: Her household is still at work.
rooms.idea: Rank chaos: heroes knocked back, dropped a rank and hooked forward.

rooms.name: The Gardener's Shed
rooms.desc: He is pruning.
rooms.idea: Every fallen ally sprouts a husk; kill the Gardener first.

rooms.name: The Dead Oak
rooms.desc: Her oak is dead. She is not.
rooms.idea: Keep Blight or fire on the Dryad or she regrows.

rooms.name: The Fool's Caper
rooms.desc: He has a joke for you.
rooms.idea: His slap puts a spore in your hand that strikes a friend; spread out and plan small.

rooms.name: The Truffle Oaks
rooms.desc: Something has been rooting here.
rooms.idea: The boar ploughs through Block, the ground gives way; strike it and catch spore.

rooms.name: The Antlered Mother
rooms.desc: The garden's heart, with the Tooth in her antlers.
rooms.idea: Rank 2 refills with roots; Blight or burn her to deny her regrowth.

rooms.name: The Lady of the Bower
rooms.desc: She has woken enough to want her garden's heart back.
rooms.idea: Burn the blooms; keep the back rank awake.

rooms.name: The Green Lion
rooms.desc: The hedge at the gate has decided it is a lion in earnest.
rooms.idea: Fire every round or it grows back.

rooms.name: The Outer Spires
rooms.desc: Two flocks and the traveller they came out of.
rooms.idea: Two flocks and a host that bursts on death; one area hit is worth three single ones.

rooms.name: The Web Fields
rooms.desc: A beetle humming in the grass, spiders above it.
rooms.idea: Webs Anchor the rear and the beetle eats every first hit; use another course on the front and keep its store low.

rooms.name: The Comb
rooms.desc: Drones feeding a host in the brood comb.
rooms.idea: Two healers keep the host up and wash off Hex; Neurotoxin or burst on the drones first.

rooms.name: The Beetle Gallery
rooms.desc: A beetle, the clay builders, a drone.
rooms.idea: A slow wall while the termites build round the still; Swap every other round.

rooms.name: The Plain Road
rooms.desc: A warden, a shepherd and a robber on the road.
rooms.idea: The Warden guards the weakest while bolts fall on the rear and the Shepherd shields the wounded; go round him to the Shepherd.

rooms.name: Under the Road
rooms.desc: A host, a pit and a thread in the dark.
rooms.idea: The pit pulls and paralyses; moving costs Toxin from the spider; keep a plain damage card for the turn after.

rooms.name: The Dry Well
rooms.desc: The tinker, the dowser and the wasps from the well.
rooms.idea: The Dowser shows his target a turn ahead; move that hero or Ward it. Hitting the Tinker costs Toxin.

rooms.name: The Builders
rooms.desc: Clay cones in the road and a warden standing over them.
rooms.idea: The Warden stands guard while the termites encase the still and the antlion pulls; move or be built in.

rooms.name: The Nursery
rooms.desc: Everything the hive raises, all at once.
rooms.idea: Four small threats: area damage first, then the drone before it heals the host.

rooms.name: The Duelling Ground
rooms.desc: The mantis bows.
rooms.idea: Riposte punishes many small cuts and a Mark makes it raise its guard; strike it hard and seldom while the others kill the drone.

rooms.name: The Brood Chamber
rooms.desc: Something enormous with something small on its back.
rooms.idea: Each dead spider leaves her alone to Hatch and her death scatters more; kill her with the spiders low, then sweep.

rooms.name: The Courier
rooms.desc: A horse and rider locked mid-step, a message held out.
rooms.idea: Stuns turn into a lash on the front ranks and Hex into a spasm on everyone; damage it plainly instead.

rooms.name: The Fallen Beam
rooms.desc: A beam across the road, with legs.
rooms.idea: Its claws reach any rank and its middle regrows Armor; stripping it makes it coil, so burst it when it does.

rooms.name: The Hive Queen
rooms.desc: The heart of the spires.
rooms.idea: Her wasps shield her and hatch again; cleanse Toxin before the rod draws the strike in the last phase.

rooms.name: The Procession
rooms.desc: The pilgrims carry their saint toward the shrine.
rooms.idea: It cannot be Stunned or moved; its Static meets the spilling comb, so Ward or cleanse before each spill.

rooms.name: The Cicada Under the Road
rooms.desc: The road heaves up round a shell.
rooms.idea: The hum rises every round until the Song; break the shell before the stress runs away, then race the wings.

rooms.name: The Peat Cutting
rooms.desc: The hags' dead cutting turf.
rooms.idea: The wife's toppled stack hits two ranks while the bodies hold the line.

rooms.name: Pinned in the Pool
rooms.desc: A catcher, a heap of leeches and a hag on the bank.
rooms.idea: The glaive Anchors, the hag pools the rank, the leeches feed: Ward or cleanse instead of Swapping.

rooms.name: The Sin-Eater's Porch
rooms.desc: A toad, a hag and the man who eats their curses.
rooms.idea: The Sin-Eater eats every Hex, Mark and course off the toad and the hag; kill him first.

rooms.name: Village Trades
rooms.desc: The barber, the frog boy and the fowler.
rooms.idea: The barber drains the front, the boy croaks and adds toads, the fowler nets from above; push or pull him to topple him.

rooms.name: Night Water
rooms.desc: A log in the water, leeches and a lantern.
rooms.idea: The log ambushes the back on the first round; two swarms want hits on every foe.

rooms.name: The Shallows
rooms.desc: Every hero pinned.
rooms.idea: Anchored heroes cannot Swap out of pools; Ward or cleanse instead.

rooms.name: The Long Grind
rooms.desc: Armor in front, a drain behind, blisters from the back.
rooms.idea: A slow grind: Toxin wears the turf Armor down while the barber heals her.

rooms.name: The Toad Porch
rooms.desc: The boy keeps filling the porch with toads.
rooms.idea: Kill the Frog-Catcher first or the fight never thins; toads burst Toxin on the front hero.

rooms.name: Under the Bridge
rooms.desc: Something heavy in the mud, and a man who eats what you put on it.
rooms.idea: Burn stops the troll's regrowth, and the Sin-Eater eats the Burn off it: kill order is the fight.

rooms.name: The Tithe
rooms.desc: The Reeve has come for his due.
rooms.idea: The Reeve takes the most armoured hero's Block while the turf-wife guards him and the catcher pins.

rooms.name: The Midden
rooms.desc: The sow breaks out of the pen beneath the houses.
rooms.idea: The charge shoves the front heroes back into ranks the hag has pooled; multi-hits on the ridge cost Toxin.

rooms.name: The Coven
rooms.desc: The hags gather around the eldest.
rooms.idea: Pools under every hero and a cord that binds the most stressed: cleanse and move, or race her down.

rooms.name: The Mire Mother
rooms.desc: The fen's mother and her hags.
rooms.idea: Each dead hag feeds the Mother Regen: leave them and take their curses, or kill them and race her.

rooms.name: The Stilt Hall
rooms.desc: The moot-hall wading toward the Mother's mere.
rooms.idea: The household drags the weakest hero in and feeds on it while the rest hold the line against the bodies.

rooms.name: The Old Heron
rooms.desc: The great grey heron in the eel shallows.
rooms.idea: Pins and pools say move; the Heron's Stillness counts down to a spear at the rearmost hero.

rooms.name: The Upper Gallery
rooms.desc: Two miners coughing at the seam, and the girl with the lamps.
rooms.idea: The coughs lay the fuel and her lamps light it; Burn one miner and it bursts into the hero facing it.

rooms.name: Toad Pool
rooms.desc: A crawler in front, a toad in the sulphur, an imp on the ledge.
rooms.idea: The toad stacks Toxin on the back; the imp's torch lights it before the fuse runs out.

rooms.name: The Canary Chapel
rooms.desc: The priest sings to the gas.
rooms.idea: Two sparks behind one fuel: kill the priest before his hymn, Soak the imp.

rooms.name: The Deep Seam
rooms.desc: Rats, a crawler and a toad, and no lamp yet.
rooms.idea: Toxin piles up with no spark: the danger is the next fight, and Black Lung.

rooms.name: The Pithead
rooms.desc: The timberman, the weighman and a carrying boy.
rooms.idea: A two-rank sweep, docked Block, and a child who costs stress to kill.

rooms.name: The Lamp Room
rooms.desc: All flame and no gas.
rooms.idea: All spark and no fuel, unless the company brought Black Lung in with it.

rooms.name: The Propped Chapel
rooms.desc: A timberman props the chapel roof while the priest sings.
rooms.idea: The prop keeps Block on whoever is hurt; reach rank 2 or burn them down slowly.

rooms.name: The Low Gallery
rooms.desc: Rats, a tub, a flame on a pole and an imp.
rooms.idea: Four bodies, two igniters, one swarm: hits on every foe and fast kills.

rooms.name: The Powder Store
rooms.desc: An ogre among the kegs, the weighman counting them, an imp beside.
rooms.idea: Two fuses on the count: Soak the keg, then the imp, or kill fast; the weighman takes the Block you hide behind.

rooms.name: The Choking Chapel
rooms.desc: The matriarch drifts over the altar.
rooms.idea: All fuel and one hymn: Burning the Matriarch is a gamble on the gas cloud.

rooms.name: The Count
rooms.desc: The overseer rides the gallery, counting heads.
rooms.idea: The whip Marks the back hero and the pony follows it; every death drives the rest harder: Guard the Mark.

rooms.name: The Feast-Day Procession
rooms.desc: The shrine comes down the shaft behind its timberman.
rooms.idea: The lamps count up while the timberman props whoever is hurt: break the shrine before the blessing.

rooms.name: The Burning Lung
rooms.desc: The mine breathes.
rooms.idea: The miners are its fuel and yours: their bursts and your Burn set off the full sac.

rooms.name: The Owner
rooms.desc: He hangs through the shaft mouth, the lamp still in his fist.
rooms.idea: Free the held hero by damage, not control: a Stun drops the lamp.

rooms.name: The Powder Mill
rooms.desc: The horse leans into the collar and the stone turns.
rooms.idea: A countdown fight: Soak the mill to slow its turn, and keep the front hero's HP high for the crush.

rooms.name: The Penitents' Walk
rooms.desc: They flog themselves down the nave.
rooms.idea: The penitents grow stronger by hurting themselves; kill them before the Might stacks.

rooms.name: The Stake Field
rooms.desc: Hounds sniff the ashes of the burned.
rooms.idea: Hounds hunt the weakest hero; keep no one low.

rooms.name: Candle Crypt
rooms.desc: A knight keeps the candles burning.
rooms.idea: Wraiths feed on their own flame; Soak them or kill them fast.

rooms.name: The Black Choir
rooms.desc: A silenced brother, a censer, and a knight to keep them.
rooms.idea: A guarded stress engine; reach rank 3.

rooms.name: The Way to the Stake
rooms.desc: A riderless horse and a goat that walked out of the ash.
rooms.idea: The Familiar knocks a hero back into the Recanter's wax.

rooms.name: The Pardoner's Steps
rooms.desc: Pardons for sale, bats in the rafters.
rooms.idea: The pardoner lifts your Hex and Doom; kill him first.

rooms.name: Four Small Fires
rooms.desc: The spared and the silenced.
rooms.idea: Four small fires; cleanse or race.

rooms.name: The Woodpile
rooms.desc: He has brought enough for another pyre.
rooms.idea: The bearer guards the hound; striking him costs a Burn.

rooms.name: The Tribunal
rooms.desc: The inquisitor reads your names aloud.
rooms.idea: The tribunal: the accused is Marked and burned; fire does nothing to him.

rooms.name: The Fallen Seraph
rooms.desc: It came to put out the fire.
rooms.idea: Kill it with Ward up: its death scatters Hollow Flame.

rooms.name: Put to the Question
rooms.desc: The irons are hot. He has time.
rooms.idea: Every round adds an iron; burst him early, and spend your Hex before the pardoner sells it off.

rooms.name: The Bellows
rooms.desc: She has not let the fire burn low once.
rooms.idea: She feeds every flame on the company; kill her and the fire burns low.

rooms.name: The Saint Unending
rooms.desc: She is still burning, and still praying.
rooms.idea: Feed the race or cleanse it; the bearer and the deacon keep her burning.

rooms.name: The Iron Bull
rooms.desc: It has walked out to the burning ground for the Saint's Tooth.
rooms.idea: Water resets its heat; the Familiar disrupts the ranks.

rooms.name: The Confessor
rooms.desc: The confessional hears your sins from across the nave.
rooms.idea: Rank 2 refills with Recanters; Block and Momentum are spent, not stored.

rooms.name: The Cracked Floe
rooms.desc: Thralls hacking at the ice. Something moves beneath it.
rooms.idea: The thralls make rank 1 Vulnerable while the worm bursts under the rear; cover the back on round 1.

rooms.name: Vent Hounds
rooms.desc: The hounds nest where the magma breathes. A miner tends the fire.
rooms.idea: The hounds Burn, the bucket quenches: Thermal Shock on the rear hero. Ward or Swap the burnt hero before the bucket.

rooms.name: The Glass Gate
rooms.desc: A shieldmaiden holds the hall door. The steam behind her is watching.
rooms.idea: Glass edges cut every hitter and the wraith shrugs physical; soak the maiden (weak to water), and do not Mark the hare.

rooms.name: The Long Table
rooms.desc: The jarl's table is still laid. The skald is still singing.
rooms.idea: The mead keeps the wolverine coming and the saga builds stress to a last verse; kill the Skald before his third.

rooms.name: The Shaft Head
rooms.desc: Sledges at the shaft mouth, one still smoking.
rooms.idea: Two telegraphed fire turns; Ward and spacing beat raw HP. Kill the Hauler when the front hero can take the spill.

rooms.name: The Snake Pit
rooms.desc: The jarl's pit has split open. The adders came up warm.
rooms.idea: Adders strike back at every hit and freeze what they burned; few heavy blows and ranged courses beat many light ones.

rooms.name: Scavengers
rooms.desc: Things that came down the shaft for the dead.
rooms.idea: Fast hitters and a wolverine that heals once at the brink; save a finisher for its second wind.

rooms.name: Steam and Stone
rooms.desc: Rising heat, falling ice.
rooms.idea: Stress from the wraith, burst from the worm; a balanced test of front and back cover.

rooms.name: The Thane's Hall
rooms.desc: A giant at the hearth, and his shieldmaiden.
rooms.idea: He melts but grows stronger every round, and braces if left alone; the maiden walls him from behind, so burst him, not halfway.

rooms.name: Two-Faced Oracle
rooms.desc: She speaks in fire and frost.
rooms.idea: She answers a burning hitter with frost and a frozen one with fire; hit her clean, with physical, void or water.

rooms.name: The Berserker
rooms.desc: Mead, a saga, and a man who walked into the fire.
rooms.idea: Every hit feeds him Might and the mead and saga feed him more; few heavy hits beat many light ones.

rooms.name: The Ore Sledges
rooms.desc: The herd is still yoked to the sledges.
rooms.idea: The ox Pushes the company out of rank and its coat refreezes its Armor; crack it with Thermal Shock, then the rest.

rooms.name: The Riven Jarl
rooms.desc: The lord of the split glacier, on his cracked throne.
rooms.idea: He wards the first course each round; time courses after it, and Ward the company before The Split Runs Through.

rooms.name: The Sleeper Under the Hold
rooms.desc: The glacier floor breathes. Miners climb out of it.
rooms.idea: Fire on her feeds her gusts; she is weak to it, so burn her in bursts and Ward the company after each.

rooms.name: The Firstbreaker
rooms.desc: A head and two arms over the rim of the deep shaft.
rooms.idea: Each phase cracks him; push him through phases fast, and keep the rear hero out of reach of the chain.

rooms.name: The Open Tundra
rooms.desc: Wanderers in the snow, and a shadow under them.
rooms.idea: Wanderers lay Erode; the shade's Volatile Frost cashes it in. Ward the front.

rooms.name: The Team
rooms.desc: A dog still in harness, the woman with the strap, a wanderer.
rooms.idea: The dog drags heroes forward into the sledge's swing; plan ranks for the drag.

rooms.name: The Frozen Shrine
rooms.desc: Saints and the eye that watches them.
rooms.idea: Heals, cleanses against Hex, and stress; the saints are the one target here weak to void.

rooms.name: The Rift Edge
rooms.desc: Shades at the edge of the rift.
rooms.idea: Void-immune shadows and an eye that spills Erode when it dies; fire or physical only.

rooms.name: The Quiet Camp
rooms.desc: A builder, two singers and a cradleboard.
rooms.idea: The stress camp: kill the child first, hit the singers every round to break the verse.

rooms.name: The Ice Holes
rooms.desc: Lemmings pouring past a dog and a fisher.
rooms.idea: Block is gnawed away while heroes are pulled into rank 1, where the line feeds them Erode.

rooms.name: The Stag's Path
rooms.desc: It makes no sound.
rooms.idea: Area damage for the drift, single burst for the stag; a hero who moves loses the stag.

rooms.name: The Vigil
rooms.desc: A wall, a healer and two voices.
rooms.idea: A wall, a healer and two voices: a stress race.

rooms.name: The Hunt
rooms.desc: It found you first.
rooms.idea: The front hero is the prey and Vulnerable makes it go to ground; few heavy hits beat many light ones.

rooms.name: The Last Herd
rooms.desc: The mammoth and the shadows round its feet.
rooms.idea: Stuns and moves do not stop the trample; stripping its Armor only makes it shake. Block and heal through it.

rooms.name: The Drum
rooms.desc: A dog, the drummer, a cradleboard, and room for the herd.
rooms.idea: Rank 4 is left for the herd; kill the seer and the stags stop coming, and the camp goes quiet.

rooms.name: The Chief's Orders
rooms.desc: The chief points, and they obey.
rooms.idea: His orders Block every foe each round; the builder walls in a Taunting guard.

rooms.name: The Cold Star
rooms.desc: The black star comes down.
rooms.idea: Strip stacks before each open eye; Ward invites Erode, so cleanse instead.

rooms.name: The Unspoken Bear
rooms.desc: Do not speak of her on the way.
rooms.idea: Hit her hard and seldom; clear the drift with area damage.

rooms.name: The Hearth Grandmother
rooms.desc: The faceless come to be fitted.
rooms.idea: The ranks refill and every fallen mask feeds her; reach the back ranks.

rooms.name: The Floating Steps
rooms.desc: Angels guard what is left of the stair.
rooms.idea: Kill the shade before its arc; each angel strikes once more as it falls.

rooms.name: The Tear
rooms.desc: Hounds come through the rift.
rooms.idea: Void-immune hounds; lightning or physical, then the choir.

rooms.name: The Broken Choir
rooms.desc: The eyes are singing, and the trumpet answers.
rooms.idea: A guarded stress pair.

rooms.name: The Throne Steps
rooms.desc: Two lions, and something small with a bow.
rooms.idea: Two heavy pounces up front, true damage from the back.

rooms.name: The Gate
rooms.desc: The gate is gone. The porter is not.
rooms.idea: Locked out, Block eaten, then the flock discharges.

rooms.name: The Ceiling of Heaven
rooms.desc: The decorations have found other work.
rooms.idea: Three back-rank threats behind one sword.

rooms.name: The Last Stand
rooms.desc: A knight, a herald, and lightning that forgot to stop.
rooms.idea: The shade feeds the herald's discharge; Ward the front.

rooms.name: Things From Outside
rooms.desc: They came in through the tears, all of them.
rooms.idea: All three resist or ignore one course; switch damage types.

rooms.name: The Seraph's Watch
rooms.desc: It is holding the sky together.
rooms.idea: Below half it lets the hounds in; burst it through the last half.

rooms.name: Between the Stars
rooms.desc: Something swims through the tear.
rooms.idea: The first hit each round misses it; open with a small blow, then the big one.

rooms.name: The Book of Names
rooms.desc: It has started crossing them out.
rooms.idea: Healing is struck out; kill the Angel to restore it.

rooms.name: The Scales
rooms.desc: It has lost the feather.
rooms.idea: Keep HP even across the company and Ward the front; the needle points at the healthiest.

rooms.name: The Shattered God
rooms.desc: The last Tooth floats where the Mother's heart was.
rooms.idea: Rank 2 refills with hounds; keep the two courses apart.

rooms.name: The Wheel of Thrones
rooms.desc: It is still turning, and it has found the Tooth.
rooms.idea: Every blow on the rims costs Static; spread Block and plan fewer, harder hits.

rooms.name: The Fourfold Beast
rooms.desc: It watched the throne from every side. Now it watches the Tooth.
rooms.idea: Read the face order; Ward before the void faces.

rooms.name: The Orrery
rooms.desc: Brass in front, a pilgrim staring, a moth and its mender behind.
rooms.idea: The moth fuels locks, the sentry soaks, the spider rebuilds the sentry. Kill the moth, then the spider.

rooms.name: The Clockwork Stair
rooms.desc: A halberd on the landing, a jack and a clerk above it.
rooms.idea: The clerk writes your striker into the table while the Jack saves up. Kill the Jack before it strikes, or Soak it.

rooms.name: Aurora Gallery
rooms.desc: Moths round a pilgrim who will not blink.
rooms.idea: Stress and course fuel from every side; cleanse or burst the moths, and Swap only when it pays.

rooms.name: The Gear Loft
rooms.desc: A sentry and the spiders that keep it running.
rooms.idea: Two rebuilds of the sentry. Water and focus fire on the spiders.

rooms.name: The Gate
rooms.desc: A dog on its chain, a lady with a spyglass, and her monkey.
rooms.idea: Anchored front, Marked target, and a thief for the Block and Momentum you build.

rooms.name: The Quadrangle
rooms.desc: The tortoise, a guard and the clerk who times them.
rooms.idea: An armoured, slow wall that shells up against long turns; Toxin and Armor-break pay off, long sequences do not.

rooms.name: The Mirror Stair
rooms.desc: A mirror on the stair, a jack behind it, a moth above.
rooms.idea: The mirror guards the weak and returns courses as Static; use physical damage.

rooms.name: The Star Tables
rooms.desc: Four small hands, each with its own way to stop you.
rooms.idea: Four small locks and thefts: a fight against plans, not HP.

rooms.name: The Horologist's Study
rooms.desc: He has been waiting for you, for ever.
rooms.idea: He locks a hero, rewinds wounds and winds back your course setups; his death frees every lock.

rooms.name: The Founder Stands
rooms.desc: Someone wound up the statue.
rooms.idea: Hold burst for the round its key runs down; a Mark only makes it shell up.

rooms.name: The Undercroft
rooms.desc: The ox still walks its circle under the dome.
rooms.idea: The ox and the sentry shrug off locks and stuns; Block for the beam, damage the sentry first.

rooms.name: The Rod Gallery
rooms.desc: Rods on the roof, a mirror at the door.
rooms.idea: He grounds the company's lightning into his own strike; switch courses or strike physically.

rooms.name: The Last Hour
rooms.desc: One minute to midnight.
rooms.idea: Countdown fight: the Jack and the hand share the clock; Ward and cleanse before each Chime.

rooms.name: The Stilled College
rooms.desc: The chapter is in session.
rooms.idea: Two kinds of lock plus a Mark, and Momentum is ruled out of order; break the chain before the motion carries.

rooms.name: The Great Refractor
rooms.desc: The telescope is aimed down the stair.
rooms.idea: Read the sight a round ahead and Swap out of it.
